prompt: Your organization has a compliance policy requiring that production database schema changes never be made without a DBA review. How should this be enforced for agents?
explanation: Correct answer: B) Block schema change actions that violate the compliance policy and require explicit authorization before proceeding

options.text: Train developers to remind the agent not to make schema changes
Block schema change actions that violate the compliance policy and require explicit authorization before proceeding
Allow agents to make schema changes and review them afterward
Limit agents to read-only database access for all operations
